description: This Java source file defines the VideoSurfaceView class, a custom SurfaceView used for video decoding in an Android application. It manages surface lifecycle events and communicates surface changes to native code.

classes.name: VideoSurfaceView
classes.description: A custom SurfaceView for video decoding that handles surface lifecycle events and communicates with native code.

methods.name: VideoSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the VideoSurfaceView with different attribute sets.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets background color and adds a callback for surface events.

methods.description: Returns the current active Surface used by the VideoSurfaceView.
